---
title: "drosophila"
---

reading drosophila file
```{r}
dcounts <- read_csv("data/drosophila_counts.csv")
gt(dcounts)
```
summarising data 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```
```{r}
d_data <- read.csv("data/drosophila_counts.csv")
summary_d_data <- summarise(d_data, 
          total_nm = sum(Novel_Mutation_Count),
          max_nm = max(Novel_Mutation_Count),
          mean_nm = mean(Novel_Mutation_Count),
          variance_nm = var(Novel_Mutation_Count))
gt(summary_d_data)
```
```{r}
ggplot(d_data, aes(x = Novel_Mutation_Count) )+ 
  geom_bar() +
  ggtitle("Number of populations with each drosophila mutation count") + 
  xlab("Novel mutation count") +
  ylab("number of populations ")
```
simulating poisson data 
```{r}
sample_mean <- summary_d_data |> pull(mean_nm)
n_populations <- nrow(d_data)

mean_sim <- c()
var_sim <- c()

for (i in seq_len(1000)) {
  sim_counts <- rpois(n = n_populations, lambda = sample_mean )
  
  current_mean <- mean(sim_counts)
  cuurent_var <- var(sim_counts)
  
  mean_sim <- c(mean_sim, current_mean)
  mean_var <- c(var_sim, cuurent_var)
}

df_sim <- tibble(mean = mean_sim, var = var_sim, diff = abs(mean_sim - var_sim))

gt(df_sim)
```
```{r}
sample_mean <- summary_d_data |> pull(mean_nm)
sample_var <- summary_d_data |> pull(variance_nm)
n_populations <- nrow(d_data)

sample_diff <- abs(sample_mean - sample_var)
print(sample_diff)

simulated_counts <- rpois(
  n = n_populations,
  lambda = sample_mean
)
print(simulated_counts)

mean_sim <- c()
var_sim <- c()

for (i in seq_len(1000)) {
  # Use `rpois()` to simulate mutation counts for
  # 17 populations
  simulated_counts <- rpois(
    n = n_populations,
    lambda = sample_mean
  )

  # Take the mean and variance of the simulated counts
  current_mean <- mean(simulated_counts)
  current_var <- var(simulated_counts)

  # Append these values to the `mean_sim` and `var_sim` vectors.
  mean_sim <- c(mean_sim, current_mean)
  var_sim <- c(var_sim, current_var)
}

df_sim <- tibble(
  mean = mean_sim,
  var = var_sim,
  diff = abs(mean_sim - var_sim)
)

gt(df_sim)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_sim, aes(x = diff))+ 
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  ggtitle("Number of populations with each drosophila mutation count") + 
  xlab("Diff") +
  ylab("frequency")
  
```
```{r}
greater <- df_sim |> filter(diff > sample_diff)
print(nrow(greater)/nrow(df_sim))
```
